controls.method: Original Ruby module/job loaded unchanged with authored Concern/ActiveJob/logger/model adapters under Ruby2.6.10. Only direct-upload metadata branch and merge helper executed; no Rails/DB/storage.

findings: Direct-upload method reuses find_by(checksum,service_name) result without byte_size predicate. Authored checksum metadata and size999 returns synthetic existing size1. This is metadata-path witness, not a real checksum collision, HTTP upload or actual ActiveStorage behavior.

merge_duplicate updates attachments before keeper counter and duplicate deletion, without transaction in inspected helper. Injected increment failure is rescued, leaves moved references, old counter and duplicate record retained. Actual DB/transaction behavior unqualified.
Successful positive merge control moves2attachments, increments counter and deletes duplicate record. No physical file deletion performed.
Job groups by checksum/service and returns duplicates.size even when merge helper rescues errors. Reported merged count can include attempted failures by source flow; full job not executed.
Duplicate record uses delete rather than physical purge; source comment assumes same file. Storage keys and service object lifetime/garbage collection remain unread/unqualified.
Form/programmatic hooks build checksum then reuse existing blob; no full byte confirmation observed. Actual checksum algorithm/version defined by external ActiveStorage, not established here.
